svg.title: The contract with a real Paperless-ngx
svg.desc: Every Monday, when started by hand, and in a pull request that changes the code that talks to Paperless, the job paperless runs paperless-contract.sh for Paperless-ngx 2 and 3. It starts that Paperless with Redis, Nextcloud with the app and the mock, and assert_contract.py gives Paperless three synthetic text files. Then it checks, with the version of the API and the fields that the app asks for, the fields, dates, excerpts, pages and errors and what /api/ui_settings/ says an account may do directly, and the test of the connection, the warnings about the token and the results through Nextcloud. The summary of the job shows the versions and every check. A failed weekly run opens or updates the issue Paperless-ngx breaks the app, and a run that passes closes it.
